title: Xi's Flying Visit to Delhi and the Quest for a ‘New Normal’ with India - The Wire China
gist: Pre-visit speculation that Xi Jinping's September 12, 2026 trip to New Delhi for the BRICS Summit would produce a Chinese investment package, a dedicated special economic zone in India, or a revived informal Xi-Modi dialogue appears to have been deflated by last-minute signals. This is a paywalled teaser, so only the setup is available.

insights.claim: Before Xi Jinping's September 12, 2026 visit to New Delhi for the BRICS Summit, media speculated that Beijing was considering a special investment package for India or even a dedicated special economic zone there.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: A Chinese SEZ or investment package in India would signal a real easing of India's post-2020 curbs on Chinese FDI, which matters for Chinese electronics and EV suppliers eyeing India.
insights.quote: Talk circulated of Beijing considering a special investment package, or even setting up a dedicated special economic zone in India.

insights.claim: Some analysts suggested Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi could agree to resume an informal dialogue mechanism after years of fractious China-India relations.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Revival of leader-level informal summits would be a leading indicator of a durable 'new normal' that lowers border-risk premia and reopens trade and investment channels.

insights.claim: Signals in the final hours and days before Xi's Delhi visit pointed to weaker outcomes than the speculation had implied, suggesting the China-India reset is incremental rather than a breakthrough.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Discount headline hopes of a big China-India economic opening; trades premised on large Chinese capital inflows into India look premature.
